### Key Risks

- **Extreme drowsiness and dizziness:** Their sedative effects amplify each other, increasing the chance of falls, accidents, and trouble waking up.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXRP_3d2Wt-dE2RUlbKCja4lXZo69ehbXDA1lYaaenM8bMizGpDbKKvTHw69dFUhwdnCwHT6GORVDOebCilKzaNmTBXQD0FyitdZ-SsbWemVFSsjWrfilTdTIoj9eIhIDjkZX0-qKCqHuH)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXXeVO04QTBO7RQfxJ-jH5uyZfgiKZvBPdZDdjGCFYF6JVRx-UBcd1tDKls4-dnaLedbpR53afDbdpcrF5TBztME-AEXgOgQfsAYTMar_XnMt5Amk6EH_Sbjwq_Yn5e-Rdbj6nG4e1sgBmx-EbjQU-zdN7b)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF1xcr2vxEaFZRiBLH1FG9fPwpDfDhcLpWWjVcGnvqrAkHCbYHeSlSQ5B_0rYI0Js8smJTF1NWBilREHnatDdei9aFnGLCyTsy-fPOU19XVAbfZaPu1PLSYRfG0-QtQ6syS7tCrkUEiUHGYhz15wVOAn9JzFCqSMY6P-yoKhv808FiHMK-2u6m2IE0AA)
- **Impaired driving and coordination:** Reaction time, judgment, and motor skills drop sharply—even if you feel alert.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXR4g8FMxNbpFWdQsHC0s9mw31jZVXweJ85wbKNmsyFST9wZO5BuVhKt3t0QydT7XAdHG8y7qwCw1axQIb7SJ_27iPjVr-jL8NbyY8qax9p0ChpBsrOsSCdE3I3tOFqhV9SaTsajDrnA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdwHEIkXXeVO04QTBO7RQfxJ-jH5uyZfgiKZvBPdZDdjGCFYF6JVRx-UBcd1tDKls4-dnaLedbpR53afDbdpcrF5TBztME-AEXgOgQfsAYTMar_XnMt5Amk6EH_Sbjwq_Yn5e-Rdbj6nG4e1sgBmx-EbjQU-zdN7b)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXXFiDZsZ8MnUg4vRPHtZ5RMOZG7YicUku8ylvgMY5IPytsZUIlk59akb10-cMb1A8cgpODbbi6apSqTVmhmDoTDyqWbszpGMRWq-xUkui9lrVRPhRtGP3QZhioUVcTXBIHLhQTSPaRBpq5r96VmB9woylNblg)
